entries.claim: Call structural variants with Sniffles2 and cuteSV from a validated aligned long-read BAM, or compare an explicitly selected second VCF.
Normalize, sort, bgzip, index, and validate the called VCF.
Report descriptive call counts and non-breakend size distributions by SV class.
Report class-aware breakpoint concordance and caller-unique counts without truth or accuracy claims.

capabilities.trigger: Call and normalize structural variants from a user-selected aligned ONT or PacBio long-read BAM with Sniffles2 plus a selected second-caller route and report descriptive callset QC and concordance.

infographic.lineage_evidence: platform-provided read-only current-task trace; agent-writable results transcripts are rejected

report.selection_mechanism: Affirmative immutable end-user message only; customer, tenant, project, account, folder, dataset, assistant, and caller context are excluded. Invalid or unavailable explicit requests fail closed.

headline_definitions.operational_definition: Number of PASS Sniffles2 records at least 50 bp after production normalization; breakends are retained regardless of length.
Number of PASS records at least 50 bp in the normalized cuteSV or explicitly selected second VCF; breakends are retained regardless of length.
Number of class-matched, one-to-one caller pairs within 500 bp and at least 0.7 length similarity, with the length criterion omitted for breakends.
Validated upstream yield/genome-size coverage used to scale caller support thresholds.
Effective Sniffles2 minimum supporting-read threshold: ceiling of 10% of upstream coverage, with minimum 2.
SHA-256 of the explicitly selected upstream long-read QC identity artifact.

caveats: Low depth, repetitive sequence, alignment artifacts, and low allele fraction can reduce detection or breakpoint precision.

inputs: Explicit aligned BAM with adjacent index
Exact reference FASTA with adjacent index
Exact completed long-read-qc-basecalling identity_check.json with computed coverage
Explicit second-caller selection and, for user_vcf, a separately sealed second VCF
A workflow infographic restricted to claims in sv/infographic_claims.json

workflow.instruction: Require analysis mode, explicit uploaded/downloaded origins, complete acquisition evidence, and a fresh external results root.
workflow.title: Seal inputs

workflow.instruction: Validate and hash-bind the upstream QC identity artifact, cross-check the operator platform against its normalized platform/read type, then require the BAM sequence dictionary and any assembly tag to agree with the selected reference and run metadata.
workflow.title: Validate identity

workflow.instruction: Scale each executed caller's minimum read support from validated upstream coverage, execute Sniffles2 plus the selected cuteSV/user-VCF route, normalize/index both VCFs, and retain per-call FILTER, QUAL, genotype, genotype quality, and read support in sv_calls.tsv.
workflow.title: Call, normalize, and compare

workflow.instruction: The public entrypoint freezes all science outputs and imported support-source hashes in science_stage_receipt.json and exits successfully with awaiting_infographic plus exact facts-derived claims/prompt. GenerateImage uses that prompt; resume verifies every frozen output and support-source hash plus the exact helper-derived claim/prompt before report finalization. Optional benchmark evidence is deterministically archived so the complete published inventory remains within the deterministic QA limit. Native platform lineage remains mandatory.
workflow.title: Finalize report and receipt

source_assertions_not_applicable_reason: No packaged or automatically selected scientific data source is used.

starting_task.decision_context: A genomics scientist reviews a hypothesis-generating long-read SV callset before read-level and orthogonal confirmation.
starting_task.deliverables: Two normalized indexed VCFs, class counts, per-call genotype/quality/support table, caller-concordance table, descriptive figures, provenance, identity evidence, dependency receipt, facts-derived infographic claims, facts payload, workflow infographic, canonical PDF report, report content and structure, full PDF review artifacts, and strict run receipt.
starting_task.objective: Produce normalized, indexed Sniffles2 and selected second-caller VCFs with descriptive callset QC and concordance, then finalize a canonical PDF and strict receipt from the same run artifacts.
starting_task.subject_input: User-selected aligned long-read BAM, exact reference FASTA, adjacent indexes, upstream run metadata, completed upstream QC identity artifact with coverage, and explicit cuteSV or sealed user-VCF second-caller selection.
starting_task.user_prompt: Call and normalize structural variants from aligned long reads with two independent caller routes, then summarize callset quality, size distributions, and descriptive concordance.
